# Add Verbose Logging Flag to Daemon Start Command

Add a `--verbose` flag to the `ralph daemon start` command to enable detailed logging output during daemon operation.

## Requirements

- Add `--verbose` flag to the `daemon start` CLI command
- When enabled, log the following events:
  - Each poll cycle iteration
  - Each child process status check
  - Each task state transition
- Logging should be detailed enough to trace daemon behavior without overwhelming output
- Default behavior (without flag) should remain unchanged

## Constraints

- Flag should only affect the `daemon start` subcommand
- Must integrate with existing logging infrastructure
- Should not introduce performance degradation when disabled
- Log format should be consistent with existing daemon log patterns

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `--verbose` flag is accepted by `ralph daemon start` command
- [ ] Poll cycle iterations are logged when verbose mode is enabled
- [ ] Child process status checks are logged when verbose mode is enabled
- [ ] Task state transitions are logged when verbose mode is enabled
- [ ] Daemon runs normally without the flag (existing behavior preserved)
- [ ] No verbose logging occurs when flag is not set
- [ ] Code changes are localized to daemon CLI and runtime modules
